Description Description The Taiwan 3D model is a highly detailed and accurate representation of the island country of Taiwan. It can be used for a variety of purposes, including graphic design, 3D printing, and CNC milling. In terms of graphic design, the model can be used to create stunning visualisations and animations that highlight the unique features and landscapes of Taiwan. This can be useful for tourism campaigns, educational materials, and more. When it comes to 3D printing, the model can be used to create physical replicas of Taiwan. These replicas can be used for educational purposes, as souvenirs, or even as part of museum exhibits. For CNC milling, the Taiwan 3D model can be used to create precision parts and components. Additionally, the model can be used to create custom molds and dies for various manufacturing processes. Taiwan DEM The elevation map is used to get information about low and high parts of the Taiwan relief. Shapefile of Taiwan The shapefile is used to cut along the contour.
